_quoi: Les libellés que l'analyse de risque d'un système d'IA rend depuis le règlement (UE) 2026/1744 : dix pratiques interdites, périmètre, annexes I et III, articles 4, 4a, 25, 26, 50, plafonds de l'article 99, calendrier consolidé. Le texte anglais suit le vocabulaire des versions anglaises des deux règlements.

# December #: end of the period granted for machine-readable marking (§ #) to systems generating synthetic content that were already on the market before # August # (Art. #, § #, added by Regulation (EU) #/#).

The code of practice, published in its final version on # June #, is voluntary to sign up to. The obligations of Article #, by contrast, are legal and apply whether or not the code is signed.
bloc.Ce sont des exceptions : n'en cochez auc: These are exceptions: tick none if none applies — the system is then within scope. The Regulation does not apply to systems used exclusively for military, defence or national security purposes, to those developed for the sole purpose of scientific research, to research and testing before placing on the market (testing in real-world conditions is not excluded), or to the obligations of deployers who are natural persons using the system for a strictly personal purpose.
bloc.Cochez tout ce qui s'applique. Une prati: Tick everything that applies. A recognised practice makes the system prohibited: it can be neither placed on the market, nor put into service, nor used. Points (ba) and (bb) apply from # December # (Regulation (EU) #/#).
bloc.Dispositifs médicaux, jouets, ascenseurs: Medical devices, toys, lifts, radio equipment, pressure equipment, recreational craft, gas appliances… High risk requires two cumulative conditions: a safety component (or the product itself) and a third-party conformity assessment.
bloc.Le résultat est le plafond légal, pas le: The result is the legal ceiling, not the amount that would actually be imposed: the authority sets the fine below that ceiling according to the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement, the size and turnover of the operator, its cooperation, the measures taken and whether the infringement was intentional or negligent (Art. #(#)). For an undertaking, it is the higher of the two ceilings; for an SME or a start-up, the lower (Art. #(#)) — and, since Regulation (EU) #/#, for a small mid-cap enterprise on infringements under §# and §# only (Art. #(#a)). The Regulation provides neither for an automatic increase in case of repeat offence nor for a flat reduction for SMEs.

texte.Auditer l'ensemble du portefeuille IA co: Audit the whole AI portfolio against the # prohibitions in force and the # applicable on # December #
texte.Avant le déploiement d'un système haut r: Before deploying a high-risk system (Art. #(#)), public-sector deployers, private entities providing public services, and deployers of the Annex III use cases in points #(b) and (c) carry out a fundamental rights impact assessment. If an obligation of the article is already met by the data protection impact assessment (GDPR, Art. #), the FRIA may refer to it or reuse parts of it (#(#), replaced by Regulation (EU) #/#); the AI Office draws up a questionnaire template (#(#)).
texte.Bareme Art. # (#M EUR / #%, #M EUR / #%,: Scale of Art. # (€#M / #%, €#M / #%, €#M / #%) applied to the turnover band declared by the user (simplified bands, not verified): the higher of the two ceilings, the lower for SMEs (Art. #(#)).
texte.Base légale pour l'utilisation de donnée: Legal basis for the use of personal data in training. Data protection by design measures. The processing of special categories of data to detect and correct biases is possible only under the cumulative conditions of Art. #a (which replaces the former Art. #(#)).
texte.Cartographier les besoins de culture IA: Map AI literacy needs by role (developers, risk managers, operators) and by the persons affected by the use
texte.Catégorise des personnes d'après leurs d: Categorises persons on the basis of their biometric data to infer sensitive data
texte.Ce niveau n'appelle aucune obligation pr: This level entails no obligation of its own: only the fine under Art. #(#) remains incurred, for incorrect information supplied to an authority.
texte.Ce système était sur le marché avant la: This system was on the market before the date of application and its design has not changed significantly since: Article #(#) defers the full regime for Annex III high-risk systems as long as that design does not change. This arrangement does NOT cover the obligations that are independent of Annex III — prohibited practices under Article #, transparency under Article # (the marking of synthetic content from systems already on the market before # August # being due by # December # at the latest, Article #(#)), AI literacy under Article # — which remain due. Providers and deployers of systems intended for public authorities must, in any event, have taken the measures needed for their compliance by # August # at the latest (Article #(#)). The slightest significant change in design removes the grandfathering and makes the full regime applicable.
texte.Ces montants sont des plafonds : l'autor: These amounts are ceilings: the authority sets the fine below them, according to Art. #(#).
texte.Chatbots, contenus synthétiques, hypertr: Chatbots, synthetic content, deepfakes, emotion recognition: the transparency obligations of Article # apply. Providers of systems generating synthetic content that were already on the market before that date have until # December # for marking (Art. #(#)).
texte.Classification selon l'Annexe III (# dom: Classification under Annex III (# areas) and Annex I
texte.Concevoir le système pour informer de so: Design the system to disclose its AI nature
texte.Conformite RGPD pour les donnees personn: GDPR compliance for the personal data used; special categories of data to detect and correct biases: strict conditions of Art. #a (which replaces the former Art. #(#))
texte.Conserver les journaux au moins six mois: Keep the logs for at least six months and inform workers' representatives before use in the workplace
texte.Constitue des bases de reconnaissance fa: Builds facial recognition databases through untargeted scraping
texte.Contrat écrit avec les fournisseurs de c: Written contract with the suppliers of components, models, tools or services
texte.Coopérer avec le nouveau fournisseur de: Cooperate with the new provider of your system
texte.Dans ce cas vous cessez d'en être le fou: In that case you cease to be its provider, but you must cooperate closely with the new one: sufficient technical documentation, known limitations and failure modes, targeted technical access for testing and validation. Unless you have clearly specified that your system is not to become a high-risk system.
texte.Description des processus concernés, pér: Description of the processes concerned, period and frequency of use, categories of persons affected, identified risks of harm, human oversight and redress measures. To be notified to the supervisory authority. What is already covered by the GDPR impact assessment can be taken over by cross-reference (Art. #(#)).
texte.Deux nouvelles pratiques interdites (Art: Two new prohibited practices (Art. #(#), points ba and bb) — marking of synthetic content (Art. #(#)) for systems already on the market
texte.Documentation élaborée avant mise sur le: Documentation drawn up before placing on the market: general description, architecture, data used, performance, training method, test records. SMEs, start-ups and small mid-cap enterprises: simplified form established by the Commission (Art. #(#)).
texte.Documenter la décision de classification: Document the classification decision before placing on the market — including where the exception of Art. #(#) is invoked (Art. #(#)) — and register the system (Art. #(#))
texte.Documenter les actions menées — sans pré: Document the actions carried out — without claiming to guarantee a given level for each person
texte.Dossier technique complet avant mise sur: Complete technical file before placing on the market: architecture, data, performance, limitations, conformity assessment. SMEs, start-ups and small mid-cap enterprises: simplified form established by the Commission (Art. #(#)).
texte.Définit les termes clés (# points, auxqu: Defines the key terms (# points, to which Regulation (EU) #/# adds SMEs — #(#a) — and small mid-cap enterprises — #(#b)). AI system: a machine-based system designed to operate with varying levels of autonomy and that may exhibit adaptiveness after deployment and that, for explicit or implicit objectives, infers, from the input it receives, how to generate outputs such as predictions, content, recommendations or decisions that can influence physical or virtual environments (#(#)). Safety component (#(#)): redefined by the same Regulation around the safety function and the health or safety of persons and property.
texte.Déployeur : informer les personnes expos: Deployer: inform the persons exposed to emotion recognition or biometric categorisation (Art. #(#))
texte.Déployeur : signaler les hypertrucages e: Deployer: disclose deepfakes and published texts of public interest, unless there has been human review or editorial control (Art. #(#))
texte.Déployeurs de systèmes à haut risque : p: Deployers of high-risk systems: take measures to use the system in accordance with the instructions for use (#(#)), assign human oversight to persons who are competent, trained and authorised (#(#)), ensure the relevance and representativeness of the input data they control (#(#)), monitor the operation and inform the provider (#(#)). In case of risk: inform the provider or distributor and the market surveillance authority without undue delay, and suspend use; in case of a serious incident: first inform the provider immediately, then the importer or distributor and the authorities. Keep the logs for at least six months (#(#)), inform workers' representatives and the workers concerned before any use in the workplace (#(#)), inform the persons who are subject to an Annex III decision (#(#)), cooperate with the authorities (#(#)).
texte.Déterminer votre rôle (fournisseur, dépl: Determine your role (provider, deployer, importer, distributor — Art. #(#) to #(#)) before listing the obligations
texte.Développé et mis en service dans le seul: Developed and put into service for the sole purpose of scientific research and development
texte.Enregistrement dans la base de donnees E: Registration in the EU database (Art. #; database: Art. #) for Annex III systems
texte.Evaluation des categories de pratiques i: Assessment of the categories of prohibited practices (Art. #(#)(a)-(h), and (ba)-(bb) from # December #)
texte.Exception du point (f) : seul cet usage: Exception under point (f): only this use escapes the prohibition of emotion inference.
texte.Exclusion de l’identification biometriqu: Exclusion of real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law-enforcement purposes, except for the three strict exceptions of Art. #(#)(h) and the safeguards of Art. #(#)-(#)
texte.Exclusion des systemes de notation socia: Exclusion of social scoring systems, by any public or private entity (Art. #(#)(c))
texte.Exploite les vulnérabilités d'une person: Exploits the vulnerabilities of a person or a group
texte.Fournisseur : concevoir le système pour: Provider: design the system to inform people that they are interacting with an AI, unless this is obvious (Art. #(#))
texte.Fournisseur : les systèmes destinés à in: Provider: systems intended to interact directly with people inform them that they are interacting with an AI, unless this is obvious (§#); generated or manipulated audio, image, video or text outputs are marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated (§# — for a system already on the market before # August #: by # December # at the latest, Art. #(#), added by Regulation (EU) #/#). Deployer: informing the persons exposed to an emotion recognition or biometric categorisation system (§#); disclosure that the content is artificially generated for a deepfake and for a text published to inform the public on matters of public interest, unless there has been human review or editorial control (§#). The code of practice is a voluntary commitment: it does not replace these obligations.
texte.Fournisseur : marquer les contenus synth: Provider: mark synthetic content in a machine-readable format, detectable as artificial (Art. #(#)) — by # December # at the latest for a system already on the market before # August # (Art. #(#))
texte.Fournisseur : système conçu pour informe: Provider: system designed to inform people that they are interacting with an AI (§#) and machine-readable marking of synthetic content (§#; systems already on the market: by # December # at the latest). Deployer: informing the persons exposed to emotion recognition or biometric categorisation (§#); disclosure of deepfakes and of texts of public interest (§#).
texte.Fournisseur d'un système à haut risque :: Provider of a high-risk system: formalise in writing, with each supplier of a component, model or tool, the information and assistance needed (Art. #(#))
texte.Fournisseur initial : préparer la docume: Initial provider: prepare the documentation and technical access owed to the new provider (Art. #(#))
texte.Fournisseurs et déployeurs prennent des: Providers and deployers take measures to support the development of AI literacy among their staff and other persons who operate or use AI systems on their behalf, taking into account their technical knowledge, experience, education and training, the context of use and the persons concerned. This obligation does not require guaranteeing a specific level of AI literacy for each person (Art. #(#), replaced by Regulation (EU) #/#). The Commission and the Member States support these efforts, in particular those of SMEs (#(#)).
texte.Gouvernance (Chap. VII) — Modèles GPAI (: Governance (Chap. VII) — GPAI models (Chap. V) — Designated national authorities — Member State penalties (Chap. XII, excluding Art. #)
texte.Génère ou manipule des images, vidéos ou: Generates or manipulates sexually explicit images, videos or audio — or images showing the intimate parts — of an identifiable person, without their consent
texte.Génère ou manipule du matériel d'abus se: Generates or manipulates child sexual abuse material
texte.Haut risque PRÉSUMÉ, à confirmer : aucun: PRESUMED high risk, to be confirmed: no specific Annex III use has been ticked. Only a listed use makes a system high-risk (Art. #(#)); the sector or the type of system alone is not enough. Tick the intended use — or find that there is none: the system is then not high-risk on that ground.
texte.Identification biométrique à distance :: Remote biometric identification: PROHIBITED if used in real time in publicly accessible spaces for law-enforcement purposes (Art. #(#)(h), three strict exceptions); otherwise high-risk (Annex III, point #(a)). Answer the question on the purpose to decide.
texte.Informer les personnes concernées par un: Inform the persons subject to an Annex III decision; carry out a FRIA if the deployer is covered by Art. #
texte.Informer les personnes exposées à la rec: Inform the persons exposed to emotion recognition or biometric categorisation
texte.Infère les émotions de personnes au trav: Infers the emotions of persons in the workplace or in an educational institution
texte.Interdit # pratiques depuis le # février: Prohibits # practices since # February #: (a) subliminal or deceptive manipulation, (b) exploitation of vulnerabilities (age, disability, social or economic situation), (c) social scoring, by any public or private entity, (d) assessing the risk of committing an offence based solely on profiling, (e) building facial recognition databases through untargeted scraping, (f) inferring emotions in the workplace and in education (except for medical or safety reasons), (g) biometric categorisation inferring sensitive data, (h) real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law-enforcement purposes (three strict exceptions). From # December #, two practices are added (Regulation (EU) #/#): (ba) generating or manipulating sexually explicit images, videos or audio, or images showing the intimate parts, of an identifiable person without their consent; (bb) generating child sexual abuse material.
texte.Interdit, sauf trois exceptions strictes: Prohibited, except for three strict exceptions — victims and missing persons, imminent threat, serious offence — with prior authorisation from an independent judicial or administrative authority (Art. #(#) to #(#)).
texte.Je suis une personne physique et je l'ut: I am a natural person and I use it strictly for personal, non-professional purposes
texte.Jeux de données d'entraînement, validati: Training, validation and testing datasets are subject to appropriate data governance practices: design choices, data collection and origin, preparation procedures, examination of possible biases. The former Art. #(#) is replaced by Art. #a (Regulation (EU) #/#): exceptional processing of special categories of data to detect and correct biases, strictly necessary and subject to six cumulative safeguards — substitute data insufficient, limits on reuse and enhanced security, controlled and documented access, no transfer to third parties, deletion as soon as the bias is corrected, reasons recorded in the record of processing activities.

EO # revoked # Jan # by EO #, replacing EO # # Jan #.
texte.L'utilisateur consulte les Obligations a: The user is viewing the article-by-article Obligations of Reg. #/#. Articles covered: Art. # (subject matter), Art. # (extraterritorial scope), Art. # (AI literacy measures, no guaranteed level — text replaced by Regulation (EU) #/#), Art. # (# prohibited practices, plus # from # Dec #; fines #M or #%), Art. # (high-risk classification + Annex III), Art. #-# (provider obligations: risk management, data, documentation, logs, transparency, oversight, robustness, quality), Art. # (EU authorised representative for non-EU providers), Art. # (deployer obligations), Art. # (transparency of AI interactions, watermarking), Art. #-# (GPAI, #^# FLOPs threshold, systemic risk), Art. # (post-market monitoring), Art. # (caps of #M/#% for Art. #, #M/#% for operators and Art. #, #M/#% for inaccurate information; the higher for an undertaking, the lower for SMEs and, on §#-§#, small mid-cap enterprises); Art. # (GPAI, #% or #M).
texte.La condition de l'article #(#)(b) n'est: The condition of Article #(#)(b) is not met: not high-risk on that basis.
texte.La fonction IA est une aide, une optimis: The AI function is an aid, an optimisation, an automation, a comfort feature or a quality check unrelated to safety
texte.La mise sur le marché, la mise en servic: Placing on the market, putting into service or use is prohibited throughout the EU.
texte.Le déployeur d'un système de reconnaissa: The deployer of an emotion recognition or biometric categorisation system informs the exposed persons about its operation and processes the data in accordance with the GDPR. Not applicable to uses permitted by law in criminal matters.
texte.Le déployeur d'un système qui génère ou: The deployer of a system that generates or manipulates an image, audio or video constituting a deepfake discloses that the content is artificially generated or manipulated; likewise for text published to inform the public on matters of public interest, unless it has undergone human review or editorial control with editorial responsibility. Manifestly artistic, satirical or fictional work: limited disclosure, without hampering the work.
texte.Le fournisseur d'un système à haut risqu: The provider of a high-risk system and the third party that supplies it with a system, model, tool, service or component specify in writing the information, capabilities, technical access and assistance needed for its full compliance. Does not apply to tools published under a free and open licence, general-purpose AI models being excepted.
texte.Le haut risque ne disparaît pas : son ca: High risk does not go away: its timetable is pushed back to a date that is now fixed. Prepare the technical documentation, the FRIA and the quality management system. System already on the market: only a significant change in its design makes the regime applicable (Art. #(#)); systems intended for public authorities: compliance by # August # at the latest.
texte.Le haut risque, s'il existe, vient de l': High risk, if any, comes from Annex III.
texte.Le plus bas des deux plafonds s'applique: The lower of the two ceilings applies (SME, Art. #(#))
texte.Le plus bas des deux plafonds —: The lower of the two ceilings —
texte.Le plus élevé des deux plafonds —: The higher of the two ceilings —
texte.Le produit relève de l'annexe I mais n'e: The product falls under Annex I but does not require third-party conformity assessment: the condition of Article #(#)(b) is not met, so the system is not high-risk on that basis. A product subject to third-party assessment for risks other than health and safety (radio spectrum, electromagnetic interference with no effect on health or safety) does not meet that condition either (Art. #(#c)).
texte.Le produit relève du règlement Machines: The product falls under the Machinery Regulation (EU) #/#
texte.Le règlement Machines (UE) #/# est passé: The Machinery Regulation (EU) #/# has moved from Section A to Section B of Annex I (Regulation (EU) #/#): for these products, only Article #(#), Article #a and Articles # to # apply (Art. #(#)). The requirements applicable to AI are added there by delegated act, applicable by # August # at the latest.
texte.Le système est-il un composant de sécuri: Is the system a safety component of a product — or a product — covered by the Annex I harmonisation legislation?
texte.Le système sort-il du champ du règlement: Does the system fall outside the scope of the Regulation?
texte.Les amendes de l'article # sont applicab: The fines of Article # have been applicable since # August # (Art. #(b)).
texte.Les fournisseurs de modèles déjà sur le: Providers of models already on the market before # August # must have taken the measures needed for their compliance by that date at the latest.
texte.Les huit pratiques d'IA interdites de l': The eight prohibited AI practices of Article #(#), points a to h, have applied since that date. Article # requires providers and deployers to take measures to develop the AI literacy of their staff — without guaranteeing a given level for each person (text replaced by Regulation (EU) #/#).
texte.Les industriels et fabricants de produit: Manufacturers of regulated products must think in terms of life cycle, product compliance and technical documentation. Machinery (Regulation (EU) #/#) moves to Section B of Annex I: it falls under its own legislation, where the AI requirements are added by delegated act applicable by # August # at the latest.
texte.Les points ba et bb s'appliqueront à com: Points ba and bb will apply from
texte.Les points ba et bb sont interdits depui: Points ba and bb have been prohibited since
texte.Les sorties audio, image, vidéo ou texte: Generated or manipulated audio, image, video or text outputs are marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated — effective, interoperable, robust and reliable solutions as far as technically feasible. §# imposes no visible label. System already on the market before # August #: until # December #.
texte.Les systèmes destinés à interagir direct: Systems intended to interact directly with people are designed so that those people know they are interacting with an AI, unless this is obvious to a reasonably well-informed, observant and circumspect person given the context.
texte.Liste des # obligations (points a à l) d: List of the # obligations (points a to l) of providers: compliance with the requirements of Section #, indication of name and address, quality management system, documentation keeping, log keeping, conformity assessment before placing on the market, EU declaration of conformity, CE marking, registration in the EU database, corrective actions and information, demonstration of conformity upon a reasoned request from an authority, accessibility requirements.
texte.Marquage lisible par machine à la charge: Machine-readable marking is the provider's responsibility (Art. #(#)); disclosure of deepfakes and of texts of public interest is the deployer's responsibility (Art. #(#)).
texte.Marquer les contenus synthétiques, lisib: Mark synthetic content in a machine-readable way
texte.Mesures prises pour soutenir la culture: Measures taken to support the AI literacy of the persons who handle or supervise AI systems, adapted to their role, their training and the context of use. This is an obligation of means: it does not guarantee a specific level for each person (text replaced by Regulation (EU) #/#). Documented and regularly updated.
texte.Mettre en place la surveillance et le si: Put monitoring and reporting in place: provider, then importer or distributor and the authorities in case of a serious incident; suspension in case of risk
texte.Mise a jour du registre lors de toute mo: Update of the register upon any substantial modification (Art. #(#), Art. #(#))
texte.Mise a jour obligatoire a chaque modific: Mandatory update on each substantial modification (Art. #(#), Art. #(#))
texte.Mise a jour obligatoire en cas de modifi: Mandatory update in case of substantial modification (Art. #(#), Art. #(#))
texte.Modèles d'IA à usage général mis sur le: General-purpose AI models placed on the market before # August # — compliance (Art. #(#))
texte.Non interdit par le point (h), mais à ha: Not prohibited under point (h), but high-risk (Annex III, point #(a)) and subject to Article # of the GDPR.
texte.Non — ce n'est pas un produit de l'annex: No — it is not an Annex I product
texte.Obligations de transparence applicables: Transparency obligations applicable since # August # (marking of synthetic content already on the market: # December #, Art. #(#))

texte.Oui — à des fins répressives (police, po: Yes — for law-enforcement purposes (police, criminal prosecution)
texte.PME et start-up : le plus bas des deux p: SMEs and start-ups: the lower of the two ceilings applies (Art. #(#)).
texte.Passé en section B de l'annexe I : seuls: Moved to Section B of Annex I: only Article #(#), Article #a and Articles # to # apply (Art. #(#)).
texte.Personne n'a repris, modifié ou réorient: Nobody has taken over, modified or repurposed this system.
texte.Politiques et procédures : stratégie rég: Policies and procedures: regulatory strategy, design, testing, incidents, post-market monitoring. Implementation proportionate to the size of the provider, SMEs, start-ups and small mid-cap enterprises in particular, without ever lowering the level of rigour required (Art. #(#), Art. #).
texte.Pour un produit de la section B de l'ann: For a product in Section B of Annex I: apply only Art. #(#), Art. #a and Arts. # to #
texte.Pour un système génératif : démontrer le: For a generative system: demonstrate the technical safeguards that prevent the generation of the content in points (ba) and (bb) (Art. #(#a))
texte.Prendre des mesures pour soutenir le dév: Take measures to support the development of AI literacy among the persons who operate or use the systems on your behalf, taking into account their knowledge, their training, the context of use and the persons concerned. This is an obligation of means: it does not guarantee a specific level for each person (text replaced by Regulation (EU) #/#).
texte.Prendre des mesures proportionnées : for: Take proportionate measures: training, resources, usage guidelines
texte.Qualifier formellement votre système sel: Formally qualify your system under the definition in Art. #(#) before classification: inference is the decisive element
texte.Qualité, représentativité, traçabilité d: Quality, representativeness and traceability of training, validation and testing data. Absence of bias verified. Special categories of data to detect and correct biases: cumulative conditions of Article #a, which replaces the former Article #(#).
texte.Quand un tiers rebaptise, modifie substa: When a third party rebrands, substantially modifies or repurposes your system, you are no longer its provider, but you cooperate closely with it: technical documentation sufficient to assess compliance, information on known limitations and failure modes, targeted technical access for testing and validation. Does not apply if you have clearly specified that your system is not to become a high-risk system.
texte.Recherche, essai ou développement avant: Research, testing or development before any placing on the market or putting into service
texte.Réponse — Classification selon l'Annexe: Answer — Classification under Annex III (# areas) and Annex I
texte.Réponse — Culture de l'IA des équipes (A: Answer — AI literacy of the teams (Art. #)
texte.Réutiliser, par renvoi, l'analyse d'impa: Reuse, by cross-reference, the GDPR impact assessment already carried out (Art. #(#)) rather than redoing it
texte.S'applique aux fournisseurs mettant sur: Applies to providers placing systems on the EU market, to deployers established in the EU, and to providers and deployers established in a third country where the system's output is used in the EU. Out of scope: systems used exclusively for military, defence or national security purposes (Art. #(#)); systems developed and put into service for the sole purpose of scientific research (#(#)); research, testing and development before placing on the market, other than testing in real-world conditions (#(#)); deployers who are natural persons using the system for a strictly personal, non-professional purpose (#(#)). For a high-risk system related to a product in Section B of Annex I, only Art. #(#), Art. #a and Arts. # to # apply (#(#), as amended by Regulation (EU) #/#).
texte.Si des catégories particulières de donné: If special categories of data are processed to correct biases: meet the six conditions of Art. #a and record the reasons in the record of processing activities
texte.Si l'organisation est une petite capital: If the organisation is a small mid-cap enterprise (fewer than # persons, turnover ≤ €# million or balance sheet ≤ €# million), the ceiling is the lower of the two:
texte.Signaler les hypertrucages et les textes: Disclose deepfakes and published texts of public interest
texte.Sont interdits : générer ou manipuler de: Prohibited: generating or manipulating images, videos or audio of an identifiable person, sexually explicit or showing their intimate parts, without their consent (sexual deepfakes), and producing child sexual abuse material. Machine-readable marking of synthetic content becomes due, including for systems already marketed.
texte.Surveillance sur la base de la notice. R: Monitoring on the basis of the instructions for use. Risk identified: inform the provider or distributor and the market surveillance authority without undue delay, and suspend use. Serious incident: inform the provider immediately first, then the importer or distributor and the authorities; if the provider cannot be reached, Article # applies by analogy.
texte.Surveiller le fonctionnement, savoir sus: Monitor operation, know how to suspend and report in the right order
texte.Synthèse des pratiques interdites (# cat: Summary of the prohibited practices (# categories, plus # applicable from # December #), conditions for exceptions and applicable penalties (Art. #(#)).
texte.Système relevant de l'article #(#) : rég: System covered by Article #(#): full regime from the Annex I date. Some requirements of Articles # to # and # to # may be limited where the sectoral legislation of Section A offers equivalent or higher protection — delegated acts of the Commission are expected by # August # (Art. #(#)).
texte.Systèmes haut risque intégrés à des prod: High-risk systems embedded in regulated products (Annex I, Section A: medical devices, toys, lifts, radio equipment…)
texte.Toutes les dates d’application par catég: All application dates by category of obligation — from February # (Art. #) to August # (Annex I), with the deadlines of Regulation (EU) #/#: # December #, # August # and # December #.
texte.Transparence — fournisseurs et déployeur: Transparency — providers and deployers of certain systems
texte.Un distributeur, importateur, déployeur: A distributor, importer, deployer or third party becomes a provider itself (with the obligations of Art. #) if it: (a) puts its name or trademark on a high-risk AI system already placed on the market; (b) makes a substantial modification to a high-risk AI system; (c) modifies the intended purpose of an AI system, including a general-purpose one, so that it becomes high-risk. The initial provider is then no longer considered the provider of that system, but cooperates closely with the new one: sufficient technical documentation, known limitations and failure modes, targeted technical access for testing and validation (#(#), as specified by Regulation (EU) #/#). The provider of a high-risk AI system and the third party supplying it with systems, models, tools, services or components specify in writing the information, capabilities and access needed for its compliance (#(#)) — except for tools published under a free and open licence, general-purpose AI models being excepted.
texte.Un système est à haut risque si : (#) il: A system is high-risk if: (#) it is a safety component of a product — or is itself a product — covered by the Annex I harmonisation legislation and subject to third-party conformity assessment (Art. #(#); assistance, optimisation, automation, comfort or quality-control functions unrelated to safety are not safety components, unless their failure endangers health or safety — #(#a) and #(#b)); or (#) it falls under one of the # areas of Annex III. Exception (#(#)): an Annex III system is not high-risk if it does not pose a significant risk — narrow procedural task, improvement of a human activity, detection of deviations, preparatory task — unless it performs profiling of natural persons, which is always high-risk.
texte.Un tiers a-t-il rebaptisé, modifié subst: Has a third party rebranded, substantially modified or repurposed a system that YOU placed on the market?
texte.Une autorité publique ou une institution: A public authority or Union institution deploying a high-risk system complies with the registration obligations of Article #; if the envisaged system is not registered there, it does not use it and informs the provider or the distributor.
texte.Usage exclusivement militaire, de défens: Exclusively military, defence or national security use
texte.Votre système effectue-t-il une identifi: Does your system perform real-time remote biometric identification in a publicly accessible space?
texte.Votre système relève d'un domaine Annexe: Your system falls under an Annex III area but meets the exception in Art. #(#) — it is therefore not automatically classified as high-risk. Document this assessment before placing on the market (Art. #(#)): you remain subject to the registration obligation (Art. #(#)), the content of which is streamlined by Regulation (EU) #/# (Annex VIII, Section B: points # and # deleted).
texte.Votre système relève-t-il de l'une de ce: Does your system fall under one of these other prohibited practices?
texte.Vérifier l'enregistrement du système dan: Check the registration of the system in the Union database
texte.Vérifier les dérogations légales applica: Check the legal exemptions applicable to biometric identification (law-enforcement purposes, prior authorisation — Art. #(#) to #(#))
texte.Vérifier qu'aucun système n'a recours à: Check that no system uses subliminal or deceptive techniques, exploits vulnerabilities, generates social scoring (by any entity, public or private), bases a criminal-offence risk assessment solely on profiling, or builds facial recognition databases by untargeted scraping. From # December #: no sexual deepfake without consent (ba) and no generated child sexual abuse material (bb).
texte.Vérifier, et documenter, si une exclusio: Check, and document, whether an exclusion under Art. # applies (military, defence, national security; research; non-professional personal use)
texte.constitution de bases de reconnaissance: building of facial recognition databases through untargeted scraping
texte.exploitation des vulnérabilités (âge, ha: exploitation of vulnerabilities (age, disability, social or economic situation)
